input.purpose: To fix scope, price, payment milestones, holdback, compliance and change-order rules for excavation and backfill at 25 and 27 Mandrake.
input.relevance: Contract basis for the Site Preparation & Excavation stage and the Foundation backfill milestone. It is the reference for checking Pennella's invoices and payments.

facts.value: Both parties signed 29-Sep-2026; audit trail marked completed 12:06:25 UTC-4

extracts.detail: Base excavation & backfill $25,500; rough grading 12 loads x $450 = $5,400; total fixed $30,900 + 13% HST $4,017 = $34,917. Tree removal is a pass-through at $250/bin + $92.50/ton plus HST.

Payments: P1 $2,500 mobilization; P2 $26,400 excavation and rough grade completion; P3 tree removal at cost with scale tickets; P4 $2,000 backfill completion; P5 release of holdback ($3,090 + tree holdback pool).

10% statutory holdback on every invoice, released 60 days after substantial completion of backfill if no liens are registered. Extra work needs a written Change Order signed by Michael Poon; otherwise it is at the subcontractor's expense.
Pre-commencement: current WSIB clearance before site entry and with each billing; CGL of at least $2M per occurrence naming TT9 Inc. as additional insured.

Backfill needs a clean, level site with a 4 ft machine access envelope and no other trades on-site. Exclusions: shale rock, dewatering, shoring, contaminated or spoiled soil, geotechnical testing and permits. TT9 must confirm utility locates before excavation.
Overdue balances accrue interest at 2% per month (24% per annum).

missingInformation: Pennella CGL certificate naming TT9 Inc. as additional insured
inconsistencies: Net payable HST in Payments 1, 2 and 4 is computed on the net-of-holdback amount (e.g. $23,760 + $3,088.80 HST = $26,848.80 on Payment 2). Payment 3 pays 100% of HST, and HST on the gross would be $3,432. The HST treatment is inconsistent across the schedule.
The owner signature block reads 'TT9 INC. (OWNER / CONTRACTOR)'.

The document is dated 29-Sep-2026, before the project's recorded start date of 2026-10-26 and before the builders' risk policies were issued (13-Oct-2026), although the contract requires insurance and WSIB before site entry.
risks: Without WSIB and insurance on file, a payment may be made against a non-compliant subcontractor.
The holdback release depends on a lien search, which is not yet evidenced.
The spoiled soil, rock and dewatering exclusions could produce change-order claims.
input.limitations: The document is a contract only. It proves what was agreed, not that any work has started or been paid.
recommendedActions: Collect Pennella's WSIB clearance and CGL certificate
Clarify the HST treatment with Pennella before processing Payment 1, 2 or 4
Record each Pennella invoice and payment against the milestone schedule
Run a lien search on titles of 25 and 27 Mandrake before releasing holdback
